name: librespot C port for Zephyr RTOS

mentions.name: librespot C port for Zephyr RTOS
mentions.description: This project ports librespot, the open-source Spotify Connect client library, to C running on the Zephyr RTOS, aimed at embedded devices. It is largely written with LLM-generated code as an experiment to see how far large language models can go.
mentions.source_excerpt: porting librespot to C using Zephyr RTOS. Mostly vibecode, to see how far LLM can go.
mentions.author: mrheosuper
